calls.taken: Someone else on the team already answered.
calls.microphone: Allow microphone access to answer calls.
calls.leaveWarning: You are on a call. Leaving will hang it up.

settings.title: WhatsApp calls
settings.on: On: customers can call you from WhatsApp and the call rings in the inbox of whoever is online.
settings.off: Customers don't see the call button. Once on, calls ring in the inbox and your team answers from the browser (with a microphone).
settings.coexistence: Not available with coexistence: Meta only allows calls on numbers connected only to the API (without the WhatsApp Business app).
settings.tierLow: Meta requires a messaging limit of 2,000 unique recipients a day or more to turn on calls. This number is at {tier}: move up by sending more quality messages.
settings.hoursHelp: Outside those hours WhatsApp invites the customer to send a message.
